brief:
Hebrew Channel 15 reported, citing an American source, that President Trump may contact Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and National Security Minister Boaz Eisenkot to request they travel to Washington to reach a deal on government formation.

The report did not specify a timeline for the potential call or the nature of the proposed arrangement, according to the Ma'an news agency.

title: Trump may call Netanyahu and Eisenkot to Washington on government deal
